verdict.rationale: Azure's own docs describe three pieces that together deliver scoped agent credentials: RBAC for fine-grained, per-resource authorization; managed identities that let applications get Entra tokens without handling secrets; and Entra ID client app registration for authenticating REST calls. The pack does not show these assembled into an agent-specific credential workflow. missing for 10: explicit docs on creating a service principal with a narrowly scoped role assignment for an agent, details on credential expiry and rotation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Azure RBAC is an authorization system built on Azure Resource Manager that provides fine-grained access management to Azure resources.
